$doc: Papercup iPhone consumer record for papercusp-iphone-app@0.1.0. Host alias and signing input names are non-secret; credentials remain external.

decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-app:iphone-app-purpose: Papercup is the paired-operator iPhone client; the closure supplies shared and iPhone chassis checks while operator, voice, push, pairing, and diagnostic behavior remains product-owned.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:product-domain: Portable paired-operator protocol, state transitions, validation, serialization, and error taxonomy live in Rust; SwiftUI owns presentation and iPhone lifecycle.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:rust-msrv: Rust 1.80 is the supported workspace MSRV.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:license-and-reposi: GPL-3.0-or-later, Papercup contributors, and the canonical papercup-rust-mobile repository metadata remain product-owned.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:design-token-sourc: design-tokens/primitives.tokens.json is the source for deterministic Papercup Kotlin and Swift token outputs.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:optional-capabilit: Credentials, deep links, push, camera, microphone, and local networking are selected on iPhone; analytics and crash reporting remain product-owned and media playback is not selected.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-mobile-base:runtime-configurat: Operator endpoints are runtime inputs, device credentials use the Keychain seam, and provider plus signing secrets remain external.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-identity: Bundle com.papercuspai.operator.mobile uses Papercup/PapercupCore/Papercup, a generated Papercup.xcodeproj, and PAPERCUP_IOS_RELEASE_VERSION plus PAPERCUP_IOS_BUILD_NUMBER.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-os-floor: Keep the iPhone deployment target at 17.0.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-capabiliti: Declare the selected Keychain, URL route, APNs, camera, microphone, and local-network surfaces exactly as the product plists and entitlements require.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-test-host: Delegate XcodeGen, XCFramework, Swift module, XCTest, XCUITest, privacy, and archive preflight to named host avis-imac; incapable Linux runs are host-constrained.
decisionPointAnswers.papercusp-iphone-shell:iphone-release: Use external PAPERCUP_IOS_RELEASE_* inputs, app-store-connect export metadata, atomic archive provenance, and no distribution action in template checks.
